name: teams
description: Microsoft Teams (read only): list teams and channels, read channel messages and threads through Microsoft Graph. Sign in with an app registration (tenant, client id, secret; admin consent for ChannelMessage.Read.All) or a short-lived access token.

tools.name: teams_check_connection
tools.description: Check the Microsoft Teams sign-in (access token or app registration).

tools.name: teams_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams the app (or the signed-in user) can see: id, name, description. Read only.

tools.name: teams_list_channels
tools.description: List the channels of a team: id (starts with "19:"), name, description. Read only.

tools.name: teams_read_channel
tools.description: Read the newest messages of a channel (author, time, subject, text, link). Give team_id and channel_id, or a "Copy link to message" link. contains keeps only messages with those words. Read only.

tools.name: teams_read_thread
tools.description: Read one channel message with its replies. Give team_id, channel_id and message_id, or a "Copy link to message" link. Read only.

tenant_id.title: Tenant id
tenant_id.description: Azure portal, Microsoft Entra ID, Overview: Directory (tenant) ID. Leave empty if you use an access token.

client_id.title: Client id
client_id.description: App registration, Overview: Application (client) ID. Application permissions: ChannelMessage.Read.All, Team.ReadBasic.All, Channel.ReadBasic.All, Group.Read.All, all with admin consent. Leave empty if you use an access token.

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: App registration, Certificates and secrets, New client secret (the value). Stored as a secret.

access_token.title: Access token (optional)
access_token.description: For a first try without an app registration: a Microsoft Graph token with delegated rights (ChannelMessage.Read.All, Team.ReadBasic.All, Channel.ReadBasic.All). It lasts about an hour and wins over the app registration. Stored as a secret.
